title: Moksha - Enlightenment
text: because because what I'm like to speak about is moksha enlightenment so moksha enlightenment is discovered when we experienced a part of ourselves that is universal that is supreme that is absolute that's yeah that's not personal at all that's the nature of God the nature of the absolute the nature of Brahman so where do we find this absolute principle the supreme principle this God principle so we discovered the God principle the supreme principle when we discover our own consciousness so does everybody know what consciousness is and where to find it I want to help you do you know what cut where consciousness is and where to find it consciousness is you and consciousness is me in every single moment consciousness is you and consciousness is me consciousness is each and every one of us in every moment I am consciousness you are consciousness we are consciousness consciousness is infinite eternal unborn undying and infinite consciousness is infinite eternal undying and infinite beginningless and endless timeless and formless universal everywhere everywhere everywhere is that clear so for example when you're looking at me now when you're looking at me if you have your eyes open can you feel that everything is arising that the whole world and everything in the world is arising within consciousness within your consciousness
